mentions.name: GitWarren
mentions.description: This is a free and open source, local GitHub-like code review app (GitWarren) for comfortably reviewing code written by AI agents before the code ever leaves the user's computer. Once installed, the agent sends the user a GitWarren link each time it finishes a piece of work for review, replicating the GitHub code-review experience. It runs as a local WebUI or desktop app, and works with tailnet and SSH for reviewing code on remote machines, including mobile reviews from a phone on the tailnet.
mentions.problem: Code written by AI agents needs review before it leaves the user's computer, and there is no comfortable local way to do that review.
mentions.audience: Developers using AI coding agents who want to review agent-written code locally
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on local GitHub-like app where you can comfortably review code written by your agents before the code will ever leave your computer. Once installed, your agent can send you a link to GitWarren each time it will finish a piece of work for you to make a review. The idea is to replicate the GitHub code-review experience.

Free and open source: https://github.com/klarluft/gitwarren-app

It works as a local WebUi or desktop app. Also works well with tailnet and ssh if you review a code on remote machines. If your phone is in tailnet you can make reviews on your mobile.
mentions.author: xfor
